Simultala Awasiya Vidyalaya (SAV) is a government-funded organization providing education to students.

SAV has multiple schools in Bihar, India, and provides admission to Class VI students through an entrance exam.

The SAV Jamui Bihar Class VI Admission 2027 is an admission program for Class VI students.

The program provides government funding for education and is open to students who have passed Class V.
